title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Release of Cargo at Destination
content:
At the port of discharge, Aurelia Hanse Line hands the cargo over against the document it issued. For `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents`, this page sets out the normal basis of release for each document type, who is entitled to receive the cargo, and the freight and once-only conditions that attach to every release.

## Clauses

1. **One release, one basis.** Cargo under a document is released at destination a single time and on a single basis. The line's records hold one release entry per document; a document that already shows a recorded release is not released again.
2. **Normal basis by type.**
   - An `AHL Sea Waybill` releases to the named consignee upon identification.
   - An `AHL Electronic Bill of Lading` releases when whoever currently holds the electronic record surrenders it on the platform.
   - The paper types release when the number of originals shown below is surrendered at the destination office. That surrender accomplishes the entire set: any other originals of the same set still outstanding are entered as void by it, which brings the originals outstanding on the document back to zero.
3. **Named consignee only.** Under an `AHL Sea Waybill` or an `AHL Straight Bill of Lading`, the cargo goes only to a customer whose company name, as registered on its profile, reproduces the printed consignee character for character. The comparison is made between the document record and the customer profile.
4. **Endorsement chain.** Where the type requires endorsement, the party taking delivery must be the last endorsee in an unbroken chain of endorsements on the surrendered original or on the electronic record.
5. **Telex-released documents.** A document in the status surrendered is released on the strength of its telex release, and no further original is needed.
6. **Collect freight.** Freight payable at destination has to be paid before the cargo is released: where the booking's freight terms are collect, the booking must show zero charges due (0.00).

## Values by document type

| Document type | Normal basis of release | Originals surrendered at destination | Unbroken endorsement chain required |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | Identification of the named consignee | 0 | No |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | Surrender of the electronic record on the platform | 1 | Yes |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | Surrender of an original | 1 | No |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Surrender of an original | 1 | Yes |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Surrender of an original | 1 | Yes |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | Surrender of an original | 1 | Yes |

## Hypothetical cases

| Facts | Judgement |
|---|---|
| `AHL Straight Bill of Lading`, consignee printed "Nordhafen Trading GmbH", caller's profile reads "Nordhafen Trading GmbH", one original presented, prepaid booking | Release on original surrender |
| Same document, caller's profile reads "Nordhafen Trading" | No release to that caller: the names differ |
| `AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading`, original presented by a party that is not the last endorsee | No release on that original |
| Any type, collect booking still showing 850.00 due | No release until the booking shows 0.00 due |
| Document already showing a recorded release | No second release |

## Basis Q&A

**Three originals were issued and one is surrendered at destination. What happens to the other two?** They are recorded as void by that surrender and nothing remains outstanding.

**Does a document in the status surrendered still need an original at destination?** No. It is released on its telex release alone.
